title: 12-Day Turkey Highlights Tour: Cappadocia & Antalya
metaDescription: Explore Istanbul, Cappadocia, Pamukkale, Ephesus and Antalya in 12 days, combining historic landmarks, natural wonders and Mediterranean scenery.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
Turkey Tours & Packages 2026–2027 | Private & Small Group
summary:
The 12-Day Turkey Tour gives each region more breathing room, combining Istanbul and Cappadocia with the Mediterranean coast and the archaeological highlights of western Turkey. Explore Istanbul’s Ottoman and Byzantine heritage, discover Cappadocia’s valleys and fairy chimneys, then spend time in Antalya before continuing to Pamukkale, Hierapolis and Ephesus. The longer itinerary allows these very different parts of Turkey to be experienced at a more comfortable pace.
Travel dates can be chosen throughout the year and adjusted to fit your plans. We arrange selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, two domestic flights, one overnight coach, airport transfers and the guided sightseeing shown in the itinerary.

highlights: Two Domestic Flights & Overnight Coach Included

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Spice Market, Bosphorus Cruise & Flight to İzmir
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. Return to hotel and transfer to airport for flight to İzmir. Arrival transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi

itinerary.title: Tour to Ephesus Ancient City
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, visiting highlights such as the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale & Transfer to Fethiye
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also swim at the Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, transfer to Fethiye. Overnight in Fethiye.

itinerary.title: -Free Day in Fethiye & Oludeniz
itinerary.text: Free day at leisure in Fethiye. Relax on the beautiful beaches of Oludeniz or optionally visit the old Greek village of Kayakoy. Enjoy free time to explore the town center, marina, and coastline. Overnight in Fethiye.

itinerary.title: To Antalya by Intercity Coach Transportation
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Check out from hotel in Fethiye
Transfer to bus station for intercity bus to Antalya
Arrival transfer to hotel in Antalya
Rest of the day is free at leisure. Overnight in Antalya

itinerary.title: Tour to Perge Aspendos and Kursunlu Waterfall
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:00, enjoy a full-day tour of Antalya and the ancient Pamphylia region. Visit Perge, Aspendos, and the ancient coastal town of Side. The tour also includes a stop at the scenic Manavgat Waterfall. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Free day in Antalya & Night Bus to Cappadocia
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Check out from hotel in Antalya
Free time at leisure for sightseeing or relaxing by the seaside
Transfer to bus station for overnight intercity bus to Cappadocia
Optional domestic flight via Istanbul is available upon request

itinerary.title: Arrival & North Cappadocia
itinerary.text: Arrival in Cappadocia and transfer to hotel. At 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia, visiting Uchisar Castle, Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum. Continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit Urgup and Avanos, famous for traditional pottery. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia & Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, Mustafapasa, Sobesos Ancient City, and Soğanlı Valley. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City. After the tour, Transfer to Kayseri Airport for flight to Istanbul Arrival transfer to hotel. Overnight in Istanbul

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 12-Day Turkey Highlights Tour: Cappadocia & Antalya?
faqs.a: The 12-Day Grand Tour of Turkey covers Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus, Pamukkale, Antalya, and Fethiye. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, discover Cappadocia's fairy chimneys and underground cities, visit the ancient ruins of Ephesus, experience Pamukkale's white travertine terraces, enjoy Antalya's Mediterranean coastline, and relax in the beautiful seaside town of Fethiye. The tour runs for 11 nights and 12 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 12-Day Grand Tour of Turkey cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,195 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights. These flights help reduce travel time between regions and allow you to comfortably experience Turkey's most famous historical, cultural, and coastal destinations.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 11 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are selected for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers throughout the tour are included.

faqs.q: Does the 12-day Grand Tour of Turkey include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience Turkey's most diverse attractions. It combines historical cities, ancient ruins, natural wonders, Mediterranean beaches, and unique landscapes, providing a comprehensive introduction to the country.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, and areas with uneven terrain. Ephesus, Pamukkale, and Cappadocia involve moderate walking, but most travelers with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Antalya and Fethiye?
faqs.a: Antalya is known for its beautiful Mediterranean coastline, Kaleiçi Old Town, waterfalls, and archaeological sites. Fethiye offers stunning beaches, turquoise waters, scenic bays, and easy access to attractions such as Ölüdeniz, Butterfly Valley, and the famous Blue Lagoon.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 12-Day Grand Tour of Turkey?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 12-Day Grand Tour of Turkey available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include optional excursions, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
